sophie_cust: Hey — after the maintenance this morning our embeddings width changed for a pinned model. We pinned to `rwd-embed-v2@pin:2026-02-28` and we used to get 1536 floats; now API responses are 768 floats. Very high impact for our search indexes. Anyone seen this?

olivia_support: sorry to hear that. Can you paste the exact request (headers + body) and a sample response? Also send an `x-request-id` from one of the failing requests if you have it.

sophie_cust: here's a redacted curl and a sample response (embedding truncated):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-embed-v2@pin:2026-02-28","input":"test sentence"}' \n  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings
```
response: {"model":"rwd-embed-v2@pin:2026-02-28","embedding":[0.012, -0.003, ..., 0.004],"length":768}
We verified locally with an older pinned SHA and it was 1536. Happening across regions.

raj_engineer: thanks, Sophie. Two quick checks: 1) can you share the full `x-request-id` from the response headers, 2) are you setting any client-side batching or using our batch endpoints?

sophie_cust: x-request-id: req_8a7f1b2c, and we do batch up to 8 items per call (server side batching via our client). We also saw it more often when batching >1.

deploy_bot: [deploy] canary rollout: rwd-embed-v3-quant -> 2026-03-02T10:15:23Z (10% traffic)

olivia_support: fyi deploy bot shows a canary for a quantized variant earlier today. Raj — could this explain a vector width change?

raj_engineer: yup — probable cause: routing fallback/mapping changed such that pinned alias is resolving to a quantized variant (which uses a different projection head) in some backends. Quantized variants sometimes use reduced dimensionality depending on the conversion pipeline. The batching interaction suggests a path where the request is routed to a different backend pool when batch_size>1.

marc_infra: stepping in — I'll check the variant mapping for the pinned alias and whether the pin points to the expected build SHA. If the pin was created before the alias rewrite, it may be routing to the new quant variant.

olivia_support: Sophie — short mitigation options while we investigate: 1) temporarily set `model` to the explicit unpinned canonical name you tested (e.g., `rwd-embed-v2@sha:abcdef1234`) instead of the pin alias; 2) set batch_size=1 or disable batching in client to avoid the alternative routing path; or 3) we can forcibly re-pin to the prior SHA on your behalf. Which would you prefer?

sophie_cust: can you re-pin for us? We can't change clients easily across many services right now. We need a fix asap.

raj_engineer: copying next steps: I will run a lookup for alias `rwd-embed-v2@pin:2026-02-28` and verify the target SHA and variant. If it points to a quantized build, we'll rollback that alias or remap the pin to the prior SHA. I'll also add a routing rule to avoid sending pinned traffic to the canary pool. ETA 30m.

marc_infra: confirmed — pin maps intermittently to `rwd-embed-v3-quant` due to an alias migration script that ran during canary rollout. I'm initiating a remap to `sha:abcdef1234` and will surface audit logs here once complete.

olivia_support: thanks everyone — Sophie I'll DM you once remap is done and we can coordinate a short validation window. Sorry for the hit here. :pray:

sophie_cust: thanks, appreciate the quick response. We'll run validation after the remap. If it helps, we captured a few failing request ids and sample vectors, happy to DM them.

raj_engineer: follow-up — for permanent fix we will add a validation gate to alias migrations that asserts embedding dimensionality compatibility for pinned aliases. Filing ENG-embed-compat-432.

marc_infra: remap completed at 2026-03-02T10:42:11Z. Audit: alias `rwd-embed-v2@pin:2026-02-28` -> `sha:abcdef1234`.

olivia_support: Sophie — can you confirm whether embeddings are back to 1536 now?

sophie_cust: confirmed, spot checks look normal (1536). Thanks all.

olivia_support: closing here once you confirm all downstream consumers are healthy. We'll keep ENG ticket open until we've rolled the validation gate across the fleet.
